description: This script initializes the SQLite database schema for the NoteMaster application by creating tables for notes, tags, and note-tags mapping, along with relevant indexes. It also manages database connection setup based on environment configuration.

methods.name: str _get_db_path()
methods.description: Resolves the SQLite database file path from environment variables or defaults to 'myapp.db'.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection _connect(db_path: str)
methods.description: Creates a SQLite connection with foreign keys enabled and row factory set to sqlite3.Row.

methods.name: None _execute(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None)
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement with optional parameters.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main function that initializes the database schema by creating tables and indexes.
